statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); printf '\033[2;32m%s@%s\033[0m:\033[2;34m%s\033[0m' "$user" "$host" "$dir"; [ -n "$used" ] && printf ' \033[2m(%.0f%% used)\033[0m' "$used"; printf ' '
